Synopsis:
    China's State Power Investment Corporation (SPIC), via its Brazilian subsidiary, has contracted a Chinese consortium (Dongfang Electric + China Gezhouba Group) to expand the Sao Simao hydroelectric plant by 310 MW for ~$272M. Commercial operations are targeted for 2030, pushing total plant capacity beyond 2 GW. The deal stems from Brazil's March 2026 capacity auction — the first hydro auction in Brazil in several years — and reflects a Chinese-led strategy of optimizing existing hydro assets to grow Brazil's renewable energy base.
